sources.title: Evard's Black Tentacles
markers: | description = Tentacles sprout from the ground, turning the area into {{Cond|Difficult Terrain|}}, attacking and {{Cond|Black Tentacles|Smothering}} creatures within.

summary: Casts Evard’s Black Tentacles once per Long Rest.

fields.Evard’s Black Tentacles: Level 4, Action, 60 ft, 20-ft radius. Concentration up to 10 turns. Creates difficult terrain. Targets make Strength saves on cast or at turn start to avoid restraint. A target already affected at turn start takes 3d6 Bludgeoning on a failed save. Leaving the area ends the restraint.
fields.Acquisition: Wooden chest in hidden room near the main entrance.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
